note: _educate illos in disciplina et correptione Domini_ – bring them up in the discipline and correction of the Lord (Douay Version); erzieht sie in Zucht und Vermahnung des Herrn (Grundl); élevez-les dans la discipline et la correction du Seigneur (Glaire). As can be seen, these translations seem to understand _disciplia et correptio_ as a hendiadys, one notion explained with two synonymous words. Another possibility would be to take _disciplina_ as intellectual instruction, and _correptio_ as referring to chastisement: educate them in the teaching and chastisement of the Lord. Philippians (Ad Philippenses)
